roles.name: Greenkeeper
roles.blurb: Mows, repairs worn turf and pulls weeds. Greens come first.

roles.name: Exterminator
roles.blurb: Hunts down gophers and grubs before they spread.

roles.name: Marshal
roles.blurb: Keeps play moving, calms waiting golfers and stops reckless shots.

roles.name: Drinks cart
roles.blurb: Drives the course selling cold drinks and snacks to whoever looks thirstiest.

roles.name: Club pro
roles.blurb: Greets golfers at the clubhouse and hands out tips. Everyone starts their round happier and hits it a little straighter.

roles.name: Porter
roles.blurb: Picks up litter and boards a broken window.
